title.zh: 关于自动公共平交道口的宣告（合并）
title.en: Declarations (Consolidation) in Respect of Automatic Public Level Crossings

completenessNote: 该法规为单篇法律文书，无分节结构；正文按官方 front 抬头逐字全录，共 1 条。

text.en:
Railways Act
(Chapter 263, Section 17(6)(a))
Declarations (Consolidation) in Respect of Automatic Public Level Crossings
Decl 1
G.N. No. S 320/1968
REVISED EDITION 1990
(25th March 1992)
The Minister for Communications has declared that section 17(1) and (2) of the Act shall not apply to —
(a)the Automatic Public Level Crossing at 10.189 kilometres on the Jurong Branch of the Malayan Railway;
[S 320/68 wef 01/07/1968]
(b)the Automatic Public Level Crossing at 7.748 kilometres on the Jurong Branch of the Malayan Railway; and
[S 321/68 wef 01/07/1968]
(c)the Automatic Level Crossing at the 4.8-5 Kilometre Post on the Jurong Branch of the Malayan Railway,
[S 239/76 wef 01/12/1976]
and that the Malayan Railway Administration of West Malaysia is relieved of the obligations imposed by that section in respect of those Crossings.
